question: A metallic solid sphere has radius 28 cm. If it is melted to form small spheres of radius 3.5 cm, then how many small spheres will be obtained?
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the sphere = 28 cm

The radius of the small sphere = 3.5 cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of the sphere = {4over 3} × pi × r³ Where, r = The radius of the sphere

**Calculation:**

Let the volume of the big sphere be V and number of small spheres be N

⇒ V = {4over3}× {22over7} × 28³

The volume of small sphere = {N} × {4over3}× {22over7} × 3.5³

According to the question

⇒ {N} × {4over3}× {22over7} × 3.5³ = {4over3}× {22over7} × 28³

⇒ N × 3.5 = ∛28³

⇒ ∛N × 35 = 280

⇒ N = 8³ = 512

**∴ The required result will be 512.**
